name: linguistics
description: Linguistics: word-centred lexeme, form, sense and definition-revision records from Wikidata lexemes and Wiktionary (kaikki.org Wiktextract), cited etymology chains, languages and dialects resolved through reviewable identity with Glottocodes and ISO 639-3, WALS typological profiles and CLDR locale data. Every definition, gloss and etymology is attributed to its source and revision.

query_examples.intent: What does this word mean according to each source
query_examples.semantics: every source's lexeme side by side with forms, paradigms, senses and definitions as published; CC BY-SA content flagged

query_examples.intent: What did this sense mean on a date
query_examples.semantics: the definition revision in force per source at that date

query_examples.intent: Where does this word come from
query_examples.semantics: cited assertions only; disputed etymologies side by side; unresolved endpoints stay cited text

query_examples.intent: Which language is this and what is its typology
query_examples.semantics: identifiers, classification path, location and WALS values with references

exclusions: machine-translated or model-generated definitions, glosses or etymologies presented as sourced
speaker personal data (recordings of identifiable speakers, informant names, contributor profiles)
language-status, endangerment or correctness verdicts beyond quoting the source
mirroring of full dumps beyond the bounded, licensed subsets
